CHICAGO HEIGHTS, ILLINOIS 60411 312/756-2110 GEORGE R. BONICK DOMINIC J. CALACCI JOHN A. MALONI Mayor Commissioner of Commissioner of Streets Accounts and Finances and Public Improvements May 13, 1974 NICK J. PAGORIA JOE FASO Commissioner of Commissioner of Public Health and Safety 
Public Property 
Mr. William S. Luhman Assistant Director: Implementation Northeastern Illinois Planning Comms. 10 South Riverside Plaza Chicago, Illinois 60606 Dear Mr. Luhman: AN 7,8,9,10.11,12,1,2,3 1 5 1. Funding for Improvement to Subject: FAP Route #23 Lincoln Highway from Cicero Avenue to Chicago Road Thank you for the opportunity to comment on the abovecited project. We are already on record as favoring the proposed improvement as it affects Chicago Heights between Western Avenue and Chicago Road. The improvement should reduce traffic hazards, increase traffic flow, and improve the appearance of the highway. This project is already behind schedule. We were promised that land acquisition for the improvement would begin in 1973. The present surface of Highway 30 is deteriorating rapidly and cannot take any more delays. We urge prompt approval and funding of this improvement. Very truly yours, Mayor GRB: v1 C-9
